title: decision: STARTTLS pipeline check is best-effort and documented as such
description: In session/lifecycle.rs lines 534-538, the STARTTLS pipelining check inspects reader.buffer().is_empty() and closes the connection if pipelined data is detected. The comment correctly documents that this is best-effort: it catches data already in the BufReader buffer but not data in the kernel TCP receive buffer. The trade-off is acceptable: a well-behaved client never pipelines; a malicious client is closed defensively. No change needed.
